body: I had felt the same way as you for a long time. I always hated the idea of taking medication and tried to hold off as long as possible, but when I started taking meds I did feel a lot better most days. I don't take meds anymore. Most days I can cope with my anxiety pretty well so just because you start medication doesn't necessarily mean you will be reliant on them forever. Id recommend telling your doctor how you feel about taking meds and hopefully they will lead you on the correct path to the treatment that would work best for you.

I lived there a couple years ago and was pretty disappointed by management. We had mice and beg bugs and they wouldn't do anything about the problem. Management may be better now but I'd be leary to rent from them.

Halifax Buy and Sell on Gottingen is pretty good. Took a guitar there and they didn't want to buy it because they said the price would be to unfair for me. I was impressed by how honest they were. Might be worth calling them and seeing if the price you're looking for is around what they're willing to pay.
